title: Service Cancellation, Statutory Cooling-Off, and Early Termination Fees
summary: Policy and fee calculations for customer contract cancellations, cooling-off rights, and notice period obligations.

sections.heading: 14-Day Statutory Cooling-Off Rights
sections.text: New subscribers possess a 14-calendar-day cooling-off window starting from contract confirmation or service activation (whichever is later). Cancellations submitted within this window incur zero Early Termination Fees; equipment must be returned intact.

sections.heading: Early Termination Fee (ETF) Calculation Formula
sections.text: If a contract is terminated before the minimum term end date outside the cooling-off window, an ETF applies. Formula: (Monthly Contract Rate * Remaining Months) * 0.70 (30% discount applied to reflect unconsumed wholesale costs). Customers within 30 days of contract expiration pay $0.00 ETF.

sections.heading: Standard 30-Day Notice Period
sections.text: All cancellations require 30 calendar days advance notice. Month-to-month subscribers can cancel anytime with 30 days notice with zero ETF. Leased equipment must be returned within 21 days.
